subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress transient tool error warnings

question: Should OpenClaw add a normal-chat tool-error delivery policy such as `all | final | off`, and what should the default and safety fallback be for mutating tool failures after success-looking replies?
rationale: Current code intentionally keeps failed mutating-tool warnings visible after success-looking replies, while this issue asks for an operator UX override that can hide those warnings.

options.title: Add explicit policy
options.body: Add a documented config surface that defaults to current behavior and lets hosted operators opt into success-aware or all-off warning delivery with focused safety tests.

options.title: Keep current safety contract
options.body: Keep `messages.suppressToolErrors` as the only normal-chat suppression knob and decline the broader success-aware policy.

options.title: Narrow to channel UX
options.body: Handle only specific noisy channel cases such as Telegram or Discord post-final bubbles without adding a general core policy.

recommendation.title: Add explicit policy
recommendation.body: Add a documented config surface that defaults to current behavior and lets hosted operators opt into success-aware or all-off warning delivery with focused safety tests.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc authored the most relevant merged warning-policy fix and documented this issue as the remaining broader policy follow-up.
